newsitem.title: NORWAY: Bid for Fokus extended by two weeks.
newsitem.headline: Bid for Fokus extended by two weeks.

text.p: Sparebankgruppen, a group of 16 Norwegian savings banks, said on Friday it had extended its 73 crowns per share takeover bid for Fokus Bank by two weeks.
The bid was to have expired on Friday.
"The Sparebankgruppen has today decided to extend the period for its bid on the shares in Fokus Bank by two weeks," a statement to the Oslo Stock Exchange said.
Terms of the bid were unchanged, the group said.

It said the period had been extended to 1400 GMT on May 23 to remove questionmarks around Fokus's statement on Wednesday it had entered talks with Union Bank of Norway (UBN) on establishing a cooperation between the two banks.
Sparebankgruppen earlier on Friday said a possible cooperation agreement between Fokus Bank and UBN would be dismantled if the bid were accepted by Fokus shareholders.
Fokus has recommended its shareholders to turn down the hostile takeover bid by Sparebankgruppen, which was made last month and is aimed at carving up Fokus among its members.
